claim: This bead's job (per its own dispatch, echoing the proposal's "Sweep obligations, stated in advance" section) is to delete the Go code that implemented NodeMatcher (removed at 056d8c5:op-55) and leave the tree building green, treating that deletion as independently completable now that the node's removal event is recorded and its cleanup bead (spexmachina-f6eh.1) is ready.
authoritative_source: spec/project.json's current modules[] no longer lists `impact` at all (it lists `plan` instead, spec/project.json:193-194) — the module and all eight of its components, including NodeMatcher, ActionClassifier, BeadReader, ReportGenerator and ImpactCommand, were removed from the spec in one structural event. But the Go package `impact/` and the `spex impact` CLI command (cmd/spex/impact.go, still registered in cmd/spex/main.go alongside spex plan) are still live in the repository, and their own cleanup beads (spexmachina-f6eh.9 ActionClassifier, spexmachina-f6eh.14 BeadReader, spexmachina-f6eh.4 ReportGenerator, spexmachina-f6eh.3 ImpactCommand) are all still status=open — none has run.
evidence: impact/node_matcher.go defines Pairing, Match, Unmatched, Orphaned and MatchNodes. impact/action_classifier.go:60 calls ClassifyActions(graph mapping.SpecGraph, matches []Match, unmatched []Unmatched, orphaned []Orphaned) and impact/action_classifier.go:383 takes a Pairing by value — same-package, direct type dependency. cmd/spex/impact.go:101 calls impact.MatchNodes(changes, pairings) and cmd/spex/impact.go:164-206 build/thread []impact.Pairing through pairingsFromFold and enrichPairingsWithBeadStatus; this file backs the still-registered `spex impact` command (cmd/spex/main.go:17). Deleting node_matcher.go (and its test) as scoped therefore breaks compilation of impact/action_classifier.go and cmd/spex/impact.go, violating this bead's own "leave the tree building green" completion gate. br's dependency graph does not encode any ordering between these five impact-package cleanup beads — spexmachina-f6eh.1 shows only a `blocks` edge to its closed originating bead spexmachina-hdkq.14 (br show spexmachina-f6eh.1 --json) — so the epic controller can (and did) surface NodeMatcher's cleanup as independently ready before its Go-package siblings, an ordering under which this bead cannot be completed in isolation.
proposed_fix: Either (a) have the epic controller treat the five impact-package cleanup beads (spexmachina-f6eh.1 NodeMatcher, .3 ImpactCommand, .4 ReportGenerator, .9 ActionClassifier, .14 BeadReader) as one unit that lands in a single PR/commit so the package never sits half-deleted, or (b) add explicit bead dependency edges so NodeMatcher's cleanup is only ready once ImpactCommand, ActionClassifier, ReportGenerator and BeadReader's cleanup beads (whichever still reference impact/node_matcher.go's types) have landed. Re-open spexmachina-f6eh.1 once no live code outside impact/node_matcher.go and impact/node_matcher_test.go references Pairing, Match, Unmatched, Orphaned or MatchNodes.
